title: Repair the Crow-derived ADC source-launch branch without vias

origin.reduction: Synthetic two-pad F.Cu geometry derived from the Crow ADC launch/branch-wall constraint. It is not the historical board, route chain, pad population, or a claim that this exact reduced failure occurred in the release.

history.disposition: The supplied F.Cu launch stops at the branch wall and leaves ADC_DOUT unconnected.
history.reconsider_when: An editable F.Cu branch connects both native pads, passes native DRC, and retains zero vias.
